draftA:
REQ-1 The gate applies to CO-50 (medical-necessity) denials only. All other denial classes keep their current Mark Ready behavior.
REQ-2 On a CO-50 denial, Mark Ready is blocked unless two things are present. The first is a non-empty clinical-note reference in DOC-### form. This is assumed to mean DOC plus exactly three digits, which the PFS lead should confirm.
REQ-3 The second is a filing-deadline date, calculated as date of service + 90 days (Northwind Health timely filing). If the date of service is missing, the deadline counts as missing.
REQ-4 No one can override the gate in v1, whatever their role.
REQ-5 When blocked, the button names exactly what is missing: the clinical note, the filing deadline, or both.
AC-1 CO-50, note DOC-123, DOS 2024-03-01: deadline 2024-03-01 + 90 days = 2024-05-30 (30 days left in March + 30 in April + 30 in May), so Mark Ready is enabled. The dates and DOC id are illustrative, since the brief gives none.
AC-2 CO-50, DOS 2024-03-01, no note: button reads 'Missing: clinical note'. CO-50, note DOC-123, no DOS: 'Missing: filing deadline'. CO-50, note blank and no DOS: names both. CO-50, note 'DOC-12' (fails the assumed 3-digit format): treated as missing.
AC-3 A supervisor or admin on a blocked CO-50 denial cannot mark it ready. A non-CO-50 denial with no note and no DOS can still be marked ready as today.
draftB:
REQ-1: The gate applies only to CO-50 medical-necessity denials, not to any other denial class.
REQ-2: A specialist cannot mark a CO-50 appeal packet ready unless a non-empty DOC-### clinical-note id and a filing-deadline date are both present.
REQ-3: The filing deadline is the date of service plus 90 days under Northwind Health timely filing.
REQ-4: Nobody can override the gate in v1.
REQ-5: When blocked, the button names exactly what is missing.
AC-1: A CO-50 denial with non-empty clinical-note id DOC-### and filing deadline equal to date of service plus 90 days can be marked ready.
AC-2: A CO-50 denial missing the DOC-### id, the date-of-service-plus-90-days deadline, or both cannot be marked ready, the button names exactly each missing item, and no v1 override exists.
AC-3: A denial that is not CO-50 is not blocked by this gate even if the DOC-### id or the 90-day deadline is absent.

reviewOfA.strengths: The draft correctly limits the gate to CO-50, allows no v1 override, and computes 2024-03-01 plus 90 days as 2024-05-30.

reviewOfB.strengths: Every requirement and acceptance criterion traces directly to the brief and the requester's answers: CO-50 scope, a non-empty DOC-### id, a deadline of date of service plus 90 days, no v1 override, and a button that names exactly what is missing. The draft also tests the negative case of non-CO-50 denials.
